integrity: Proof derives local adjacency quotient and explicit connecting paths; finite brute force is separate reproducibility evidence, not a substitute for the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary minimum-set token-jumping for circular ladders with n at least 6 only. The previously established five-orbit minimum-set classification is not a new contribution. Exact graph diameter and token sliding are not addressed. No independent validation; incomplete bibliographic indexing cannot exclude unnoticed equivalent publications.
title: Token-jumping geometry of minimum zero-forcing sets on circular ladders
